title: Loop clip gallery
logline: A short loop for X (docs/decisions/0008): frame one is the before state with the cursor already on the slider; one reveal — a depth swap to the after state — then a long hold that cuts cleanly back to the start. Reference + lint fixture.
caption: Skeletons tell people to wait. A sheet tells them it's ready. One slider, before and after. (demo + code in thread)

scenes.intent: Before → after in one move: the cursor drags the slider, the skeleton phone steps back, the finished phone steps forward over it, then everything holds.
scenes.motion: Frame one: the before phone and the cursor on the thumb, already pressing. Drag on inOut (linger), value counts. At the swap the before phone steps back and tilts while the after phone steps forward on glide; its rows settle 2 frames apart; the cursor lets go and leaves. Hold ~50%, then the loop cuts back to frame one.
